name: Wallis and Futuna
officialName: Territory of the Wallis and Futuna Islands

flag.description: A red field with the French tricolour, outlined in white, in the upper hoist corner, and in the fly a white saltire-like emblem of four triangles whose points meet in the middle. It is a local flag; the official flag is the French tricolour.
flag.symbolism: The red field and white emblem come from the traditional royal flag of Uvea (Wallis); the tricolour in the corner marks the tie with France.

hook: Wallis and Futuna is a red flag with a little French tricolour tucked in its corner and a white four-triangle cross floating in the fly.
trivia: The territory keeps three traditional kingdoms, Uvea on Wallis and Alo and Sigave on Futuna, whose kings are recognised under French law.
More Wallisians and Futunans live in New Caledonia than in Wallis and Futuna itself.
